name: czrecoil_frame_on_menu_about
description: CZRecoilFrame::OnMenuAbout constructs the About dialog, runs it modally, and destroys the dialog stack object.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x430c30 yet; the handler currently has functional evidence only.
The native smoke patches only the smoke process MFC42 ordinal imports for CDialog::CDialog(UINT, CWnd*), CDialog::DoModal, and CDialog::~CDialog, and restores them before return.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation at 0x430c30 validates stack CAboutDlg construction with null parent, CDialog::DoModal, and CDialog::~CDialog cleanup through the EH-framed local lifetime.
The native smoke verifies the constructor, modal call, and destructor occur once and in order against the same stack dialog object.
